channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Michelle chama Mendonça de 'ungido do Senhor' em meio a crise no STF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro criticized Alexandre de Moraes and defended Supreme Court minister André Mendonça, calling Moraes 'the Lord's unguided one' during the institutional crisis. The post sparked reactions in national politics.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral vai avaliar percepção do eleitorado sobre pleito
item.description: The Electoral Justice established a working group to assess voter perception regarding the 2026 elections, aiming to promote transparency and improve the electoral process. The group will be coordinated by the TSE and is expected to deliver a report by March 2027.

item.title: Presente em jantar com Lula, Rubens Ometto doa R$ 2 milhões ao PT
item.description: Rubens Ometto, after attending Lula's dinner at Alvorada Palace, donated R$2 million to the PT for the re-election campaign. The donation took place in the context of an event that gathered 16 major entrepreneurs and bankers.

item.title: Botafogo x Palmeiras opõe crise e liderança no Brasileirão; veja odds
item.description: Botafogo is facing a crisis in the Brazilian Championship, with three consecutive losses, and hosts the leader Palmeiras at Nilton Santos. Fans protested at the training center, increasing pressure on the team. The odds show Palmeiras as the favorite (2.10), followed by a draw (3.40) and Botafogo (3.35).

item.title: Modelo de gasto público e consumo turbinados do governo Lula já provoca ressaca econômica
item.description: President Lula's administration continues stimulus policies and tax waivers, yet the economy grapples with high interest rates, rising debt and record defaults. Both businesses and households struggle with loan costs, prompting expert warnings of a potential downturn.

item.title: 4 lances do terremoto institucional: Fachin, aviso de Lula, prece e Kassab
item.description: The clash between Supreme Court justices triggered an institutional crisis involving President Lula and figures such as Fachin, Mendonça, and Kassab, with allegations of bribes and selective leaks. Internal tension within the judiciary heightened concerns over the Justice's image and governance in the country.

item.title: Só vale o real: como vão funcionar as regras do TSE para uso de IA nas eleições
item.description: The TSE set rules for AI use in campaigns, banning deepfakes and avatars with high realism. The controversy involved a Bolsonaro avatar used at PL's convention, not deemed early campaigning. The new ruling aims to prevent manipulation of real or fictional individuals' images and voices.

item.title: Motta e Alcolumbre confirmam presença no 7 de Setembro de Lula
item.description: The presidents of the Chamber, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), and the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), confirmed their attendance at the 7 de Setembro civic parade in Brasília. Both are running for re-election: Motta for the Chamber and Alcolumbre for the Senate, while also lobbying support to remain as speaker next year.

item.title: Saiba como se proteger de golpes que usam nome da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Fake messages using the name of the Electoral Justice may trick voters by requesting payments or personal data. To protect yourself, check any pending issues through the official TSE Portal, Self-Service platform, or e-Título app. Never trust links or information sent via WhatsApp or email without prior verification.

item.title: Petistas veem "vantagem" em votar PEC 6x1 somente após o 1º turno
item.description: Despite public criticism from Lula, a wing of the PT sees an advantage in voting the PEC 6×1 only after the first round, believing it provides more time to position the issue as an electoral strategy. Davi Alcolumbre's decision to postpone the vote was interpreted as a tactical move that may favor Lula and complicate the Bolsonarists' campaign.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Lula argues that candidates should be judged by their past record, not just future promises. He stresses the importance of knowing the history of those running to understand what they have actually done. The statement criticizes political superficiality and advocates analyzing each candidate's track record.

item.title: Internacional e Santos fazem duelo contra o rebaixamento no Beira-Rio
item.description: Internacional and Santos face off at Beira-Rio in the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship, in a crucial match in the relegation battle. With 18th place, Internacional needs to react, while Santos, in 14th place, seeks to pull away from the danger zone but arrives weakened by the absence of Neymar and other players. Both teams are coming off eliminations in the Copa do Brasil.

item.title: Corinthians recebe a Chapecoense na sequência do Brasileirão na Neo Química Arena
item.description: Corinthians hosts Chapecoense in the 26th round of the Brasileirão, seeking to recover confidence after three consecutive defeats. With important absences, the team needs a victory to get closer to the G5. Chapecoense, last in the table with only 14 points, also tries to react in the competition.

item.title: Valencia x Barcelona na La Liga: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Barcelona, unbeaten so far with 12 goals scored and only two conceded, faces Valencia, who are still seeking their first win of the season, on Sunday at 11:15 AM (Brasília time) at Mestalla in La Liga's fourth round. The match will be broadcast by CazéTV and Prime Video. Barcelona looks to maintain their perfect start, while Valencia aims to turn around their poor beginning.

item.title: Coritiba x Mirassol no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Coritiba and Mirassol face off on Sunday, the 6th, at 11 AM Brasilia time, at Couto Pereira, in the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship. Coritiba is on a high, having won the last two rounds, while Mirassol is struggling with only one win in their last 11 games. The match will be broadcast exclusively on Premiere.

item.title: A providência que o chefe da PF não descarta tomar contra André Mendonça
item.description: Andrei Rodrigues, mentioned in a report submitted by André Mendonça to the STF, questions the investigation into messages from Daniel Vorcaro, claiming his name was linked to inquiries without basis. He criticizes the actions of authorities, including Minister Alexandre de Moraes and former Minister Paulo Gonet, suggesting political pressure. The article reflects institutional tensions amid corruption investigations.

item.title: Em números, o descompasso entre brancos e negros nas urnas brasileiras
item.description: New studies by Insper's Núcleo de Estudos Raciais show that Black candidates increased in Brazilian elections from 2014 to 2022, but the rise was smaller among those elected. The data highlights persistent racial disparities in the electoral landscape.

item.title: Concorda ou não?
item.description: A poll shows that 67.9% of the 976 readers oppose the mandatory retirement of Supreme Court justices at age 75. The majority of readers disagree with the current rule allowing justices to remain in office until that age. The debate centers around pension reform and the need for renewal at the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Planalto mobiliza militância para lotar 7 de Setembro, mas proíbe propaganda política
item.description: The Planalto Palace mobilizes social movements and Lula supporters to fill the September 7th event at the Esplanada dos Ministéririos, while banning political propaganda at the venue.

item.title: Pedidos de impeachment de ministros do STF pressionam Alcolumbre, alvo do Conselho de Ética
item.description: The disclosure of messages between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro intensified pressure on Davi Alcolumbre for the Senate to pursue impeachment requests against Supreme Court justices. Three new motions for disciplinary proceedings were filed with the Senate Ethics Council against Alcolumbre, whose body has been inactive for over two years.

item.title: Crise de Moraes cola mais em Lula que escândalo com Lulinha
item.description: The crisis involving Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes is more damaging to Lula's image than scandals involving his son. Three corruption episodes have shaken the president's popularity, but the Vorcaro/Moraes case has greater electoral impact potential. Lula is making calculated gestures to avoid being linked to the controversy.

item.title: E se o Estado pudesse fazer mais com o mesmo dinheiro?
item.description: The PEC 17/2024, addressing the autonomy of the Public Ministry, was recently appended to PEC 82/2007 and is now heading to the floor of the Chamber of Deputies. This autonomy strengthens state legal oversight, allowing public prosecutors and lawyers to act independently when reviewing tenders, contracts, and public policies. Previously limited to civil servants, the issue becomes a collective concern by ensuring transparency and efficiency in public spending.

item.title: Eleições 2026 | Em um eventual 2° turno você vota em Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro?
item.description: The question discusses a hypothetical runoff election between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Jair Messias Bolsonaro, reflecting Brazil's political polarization ahead of the 2026 elections. The content encourages voter engagement but lacks substantive analysis.

item.title: Una guerra interna en el Supremo de Brasil pone en vilo las elecciones presidenciales
item.description: An internal crisis at the Brazilian Supreme Federal Court, involving corruption allegations against Justice Alexandre de Moraes, is shaking the political landscape just weeks before the 2026 elections. Polls show a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, with a third candidate rising. Judicial tensions may influence the electoral race.

item.title: Em meio à crise no STF, Michelle posta mensagem de apoio para Mendonça
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro posted a supportive message for Minister André Mendonça, sharing a photo and recalling personal moments, amid the ongoing STF crisis between him and Alexandre de Moraes. The post takes place during her Senate campaign in the Federal District. The support emphasizes Mendonça's spiritual journey and principles, without directly addressing the allegations involving Moraes and Vorcaro.

item.title: Semana de Lula tem vitórias parciais no Congresso, mas PECs do fim da 6x1 e da Segurança ficam para depois da eleição
item.description: The concentrated week in Congress resulted in partial victories for Lula, with PECs on 6x1 and Public Security postponed after the election. The STF crisis between Moraes and Mendonça complicates the government agenda, as Alcolumbre resists pressure for impeachment. Advancing reforms will require delicate balancing between government and electoral campaign.

item.title: Telefone fixo, disquetes e cinco 'ninjas': os bastidores da criação da urna eletrônica
item.description: In 1998, electronic voting machines were first tested in Acaraú, Ceará, as part of the TSE's effort to modernize voting and combat fraud. A group of five specialists, known as 'the ninjas', developed the equipment, including Mauro Hashioka and Giuseppe Janino. The technology aimed to replace paper voting and was widely adopted by 2000.

item.title: Data centers, 5G e valorização da Caatinga: as propostas dos candidatos a presidente para o Nordeste
item.description: Five presidential candidates - Caiado, Cury, Renan Santos, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Lula - highlight specific proposals for the Northeast, such as data centers, 5G, railways, and Caatinga preservation. Other candidates, like Zema and Martins, also address the region but with less emphasis. Some, like Marçal and Costa, do not commit to responding or avoid direct mentions of the Northeast.

item.title: Governo federal projeta receita total de R$ 3,24 trilhões em 2026; número é recorde e equivale a 23,7% do PIB
item.description: The federal government projects total revenue of R$3.24 trillion in 2026, equivalent to 23.7% of GDP, marking a new historical record. Forecasts indicate a slight reduction in 2027 to 23.4% of GDP, with a surplus of R$18.6 billion. Revenue growth is driven mainly by oil exploration, boosted by the international context.

item.title: Menções ao STF crescem 269% depois de diálogos Moraes-Vorcaro
item.description: Social media mentions of the STF surged 269% this week, driven by PF documents linking Minister Moraes to Daniel Vorcaro. The 2026 electoral campaign sees higher engagement when addressing the STF crisis, particularly for Zema, Bolsonaro and Caiado.

item.title: São Paulo vence mais uma e acaba com invencibilidade do Atlético-MG
item.description: São Paulo defeated Atlético-MG 2-0 at Morumbi, ending the Galo's 14-match unbeaten run this season. Goals from Luciano and Iago decided the game in the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship.

item.title: Deputado Júlio César faz campanha ao Senado PI no como “Julim do Lula”
item.description: Federal Congressman Júlio César (PSD-PI) launched his Senate campaign in Piauí under the nickname 'Julim do Lula', publicly aligning with President Lula. The strategy was released in an AI-generated video on Instagram. According to an AtlasIntel poll, Marcelo Castro leads with 22.4%, followed by Júlio César (17.2%) and Ciro Nogueira (13.3%).

item.title: Cármen Lúcia vê erros tanto de Moraes quanto de Mendonça e vira peça-chave na disputa por hegemonia no STF
item.description: Justice Cármen Lúcia criticizes decisions by Moraes and Mendonça that led the STF into an institutional crisis, and has not yet declared support for either.

item.title: R$ 186,89 bilhões: Pix bate recorde diário de operação, diz Banco Central
item.description: Pix hit a daily transaction record with over 318 million operations, signaling strong adoption of Brazil's instant payment system.

item.title: Flávio visita Filipe Martins na prisão e critica Moraes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visited former advisor Filipe Martins in prison, calling him 'wrongfully convicted' and accusing Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes of targeting political opponents. He challenged the legality of the January 8 convictions and pledged to restore the credibility of the Supreme Court if elected.

item.title: Resultado das eleições preocupa mais eleitores de Flávio do que de Lula
item.description: A Datafolha survey reveals that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) voters are more concerned about the outcome of the 2026 presidential election than they were in 2022, whereas Lula (PT) voters show less anxiety. Among Flávio supporters, 63% report increased worry; among Lula supporters, only 30% feel the same. Despite this concern, 57% of voters say they are more determined to vote than in the previous election. The survey interviewed 2,002 respondents between September 1st and 2nd.

item.title: Zanin vota contra pedido de liberdade para Bolsonaro no STF
item.description: Minister Cristiano Zanin voted against Jair Bolsonaro's release at the STF, keeping a 2-0 vote against the habeas corpus. The reporting minister Carmen Lúcia also rejected the request.

item.title: Zanin pede responsabilização de envolvidos após Deltan publicar dados de seu sigilo bancário
item.description: STF Minister Cristiano Zanin requested the Paraná Electoral Court to hold accountable those involved after Deltan Dallagnol, a former prosecutor and Novo candidate, published his bank secrecy data. The move seeks to investigate potential irregularities in the disclosure of financial information during an election campaign.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes propõe barrar policiais e militares em gabinetes de ministros do STF
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes proposed an amendment to the STF's internal rules to prevent police officers and military personnel from working in ministers' offices. The measure aims to avoid conflicts of interest and was introduced amid a crisis involving ministers Moraes and Mendonça related to Master Bank investigations. The proposal still needs approval from the STF's Permanent Rules Commission.

item.title: Mello se diz arrependido por ter apoiado a indicação de Moraes ao STF
item.description: Retired Supreme Court Justice Marco Aurélio Mello expressed regret for having supported Alexandre de Moraes's appointment, calling the allegations involving chats with former banker Daniel Vorcaro 'very serious.' He recalled recommending Moraes to former President Michel Temer after the plane crash that killed Justice Teori Zavasicki, but now acknowledges the support was a mistake. Mello also backed Justice André Mendonça, criticizing Moraes and warning of a reversal of values at the Supreme Court.

item.title: “Uma hora essa invencibilidade ia acabar”, diz Renan Lodi após derrota do Atlético-MG
item.description: Renan Lodi commented on Atlético-MG's loss to São Paulo, ending a 14-game unbeaten run in the season. Despite the negative result, the defender acknowledged the setback and emphasized the need to bounce back quickly in upcoming fixtures, including matches in the Sudamericana and Brasileirão.

item.title: Ciro diz ter buscado ajuda psicológica após briga com irmão Cid
item.description: Ciro Gomes, candidate for Ceará governor by PSDB, revealed he sought psychological help after a 2022 argument with his brother, Senator Cid Gomes. The rift between the brothers stemmed from disagreements over the Ceará election race and opposing endorsements in the presidential race. Ciro stated he chose not to publicly criticize his brother and considers the matter closed.

item.title: São Paulo define vitória sobre Atlético-MG em dois minutos e sobe na tabela
item.description: São Paulo defeated Atlético-MG 2-0 in the Brasileirão with goals from Luciano and Iago within two minutes, moving to 10th place with 33 points. The match featured São Paulo's dominance in the first half and a decisive second-half start.

item.title: “Moro tem convicção de que eu não fiz nada de errado”, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Sergio Moro no longer believes in his alleged corruption related to the 'rachadinhas' scheme and that they are united in the gubernatorial race in Paraná. During a prison visit to Filipe Martins, he also criticized Lula and the Federal Police, accusing the government of interfering in investigations.

item.title: Lula para empresários: 'Nunca tinha ouvido falar desse Cury!'
item.description: At a meeting with business leaders, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed surprise over Augusto Cury's surge in polls, admitting he did not know him. He asked if anyone present was familiar with Cury, revealing unawareness of the politician's profile.

item.title: TSE leva urna eletrônica a Copacabana para simular votação
item.description: The TSE conducted a voting simulation in Copacabana to demonstrate the electronic ballot box and encourage voter interaction with the equipment ahead of the 2026 elections. The event featured two ballot boxes, one opened to display security mechanisms and another for voting simulation, along with informational materials and a new accessible interface.

item.title: Zanin aciona STF após exposição de dados em candidatura de Deltan
item.description: STF Minister Cristiano Zanin requested court measures after his personal financial data was disclosed in Deltan Dallagnol's Senate candidacy filing in Paraná. The move questions the legality of releasing sensitive personal information in electoral processes.

item.title: Datafolha: 46% estão mais preocupados com eleição do que em 2022 e 57% mais decididos a votar
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 46% of Brazilian voters are more concerned about the 2026 presidential election result than in 2022, while 57% feel more decided to vote. Voters for Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are statistically tied in both concern and voting determination.

item.title: LULA entrega o DESESPERO: "TEM que DAR com o PAU AGORA" porque eu TOU PERDENDO a ELEIÇÃO
item.description: Lula shows desperation in speech, stating he must solve problems urgently because he is losing the election. Phrase goes viral as 'MUST SOLVE WITH A STICK RIGHT NOW'.

item.title: Zanin pede que Deltan Dallagnoll seja responsabilizado por abrir seu sigilo fiscal
item.description: STF minister Cristiano Zanin asked the Paraná Electoral Court to hold Deltan Dallagnol accountable for leaking confidential fiscal and banking documents in his Senate candidacy filing. Dallagnol claimed the documents were part of disciplinary complaints filed by Zanin when he represented Lula, and copies were submitted to court transparently.
